dishes.name: İskender kebap
dishes.desc: Sliced doner on pieces of pide with tomato sauce, yogurt and sizzling butter. Said to have been first served by İskender Efendi in Bursa in 1867.

dishes.name: İnegöl köfte
dishes.desc: Grilled meatballs of lamb and beef mixed without added spices, tied to the town of İnegöl in the province. Reportedly brought by Balkan migrants in the late 19th century.

dishes.name: Pideli köfte
dishes.desc: Like İskender but with grilled meatballs laid over pide instead of doner. A Bursa dish served at kebab houses.

dishes.name: Kemalpaşa dessert
dishes.desc: A semolina-based syrup dessert from Mustafakemalpaşa, first known as cheese dessert because of the local cheese made for it. It is soaked in sweet syrup.

dishes.name: Kestane şekeri
dishes.desc: Candied chestnuts made from Uludağ chestnuts, a symbol of the city. The Şekerciler Çarşısı has sold them since the early 1900s.
